description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of task counts across nine linguistic categories—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—comparing the performance of two multilingual models, mBERT and XLM-R, along with cases where their performance was equivalent (“same”), as evaluated in morphosyntactic probing tasks. The horizontal axis lists the linguistic categories in the specified order, while the vertical axis, labeled “task count,” ranges from 0 to 40 with major tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category features three adjacent bars: light blue for mBERT, dark blue for XLM-R, and light green for “same,” as indicated by the legend in the top-right corner. In IE-Baltic, XLM-R (dark blue) reaches approximately 10 tasks, while mBERT (light blue) is near 0 and “same” (light green) is around 7. In IE-Germanic, mBERT is at ~4, XLM-R at ~18, and “same” at ~22. For IE-Indic, mBERT is near 1, XLM-R at ~5, and “same” at ~4. In IE-Romance, mBERT is ~4, XLM-R ~13, and “same” ~30. IE-Slavic shows the highest values: mBERT ~12, XLM-R ~39, and “same” ~28. IE-other has mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~6, and “same” ~8. Isolate shows mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, and “same” ~1. Semitic has mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~7, and “same” ~1. Uralic shows mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~14, and “same” ~5. The chart visually emphasizes that XLM-R frequently outperforms mBERT, especially in IE-Slavic and IE-Romance, while “same” often represents a significant portion of tasks, particularly in IE-Germanic and IE-Romance. No bars are sorted by height; they are grouped by linguistic category. The tallest bar is XLM-R in IE-Slavic (~39), and the shortest bars (near 0) are mBERT in IE-Indic, IE-other, and Semitic.
caption_used: The bar chart compares task counts across linguistic categories for mBERT and XLM-R models, alongside tasks where performance was the same. The horizontal axis lists categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents task count, ranging from 0 to 40. In the IE-Baltic category, XLM-R consistently outperforms mBERT, with task counts exceeding 15. IE-Germanic shows a notable decline in mBERT performance, with task counts below 5, while XLM-R and 'same' are roughly equal at around 20. IE-Slavic demonstrates the highest task count for XLM-R, surpassing 45, while mBERT remains stable at approximately 10 tasks. The Isolate category exhibits minimal variation, with all models performing similarly at around 5 tasks. The legend, located in the top right, clarifies the color coding for mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and 'same' (light green).
